ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; dark pixels dominate the central peduncle area and leading edges, while high-intensity pixels occupy the majority of the lateral lobe surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions on the distal surfaces of both lobes. Dense black mottling and stippling present along the leading edge and radiating from the medial notch. Fine-grained dark focal spots are scattered across the white ventral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth is significant relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks varies between 5 and 12 pixels; most pronounced serrations occur on the distal 30% of each lobe's trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to sharply tapered, posteriorly-swept tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark-pixel clusters (mottling) on the high-intensity white background, particularly visible on the mid-section of the right lobe and near both tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation on the outer edge of the left lobe (viewer left), indicative of healed physical trauma or tissue loss at the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical linear stippling pattern (dark-on-light) extending from the leading edge toward the center of the right lobe.
